units.source_text: 在饭桌旁一坐下，我就从夫人的表情大致推测到了事情的进展。

en.t: As soon as I sat down at the dining table, I could more or less infer from the mistress's expression how things had gone.

units.source_text: 但我担心夫人会当着我的面把这件事情的经过一五一十地告诉K，

en.t: But I was afraid that, right in front of me, she would tell K every detail of what had happened,

units.source_text: 那我可就难堪了，而且对这类事夫人一向是满不在乎的。

en.t: which would have put me in a terribly awkward position, and she had always been quite unconcerned about such things.

units.source_text: 我的心提到了嗓子眼儿，幸而K又恢复了往日的沉默。

en.t: My heart was in my throat, but fortunately K returned to his usual silence.

units.source_text: 心情比平时显得愉快的夫人，也终于没有把我所担心的事讲出来。

en.t: The mistress, who seemed in better spirits than usual, also ended up not saying the thing I had been afraid she would say.

units.source_text: 我这才松了一口气，回到自己房中。

en.t: Only then did I breathe a sigh of relief and return to my room.

units.source_text: 但是，我不能不考虑今后该如何面对K的问题。

en.t: But I could not help thinking about how I should face K from then on.

units.source_text: 我在心里设想了好多为自己辩解的理由，

en.t: In my mind, I imagined many reasons with which I might defend myself,

units.source_text: 但是任何辩解都不足以使我坦然地面对K。

en.t: but none of those defenses was enough to let me face K calmly.

units.source_text: 卑怯的我，无论如何也不愿自己去向K作出解释。

en.t: Cowardly as I was, I could not bring myself to explain things to K in person.
